summary: Independent re-review after the reduction-reagent correction found no blocker or important issues. comment[reduction reagent]=not available resolves the DTT/TCEP conflict; CAA alkylation and Lys-C+Trypsin remain supported by both the PRIDE UbiSite protocol and the cited Bekker-Jensen 2017 46-fraction workflow.
